body:
It seems like the error is gone when using `DynamicWidgets` component:

```
<InstantSearchNext
  routing
  indexName='queryIndex'
  searchClient={searchClient}
>
  <Configure ruleContexts={[]} />

  <DynamicWidgets>
    <Panel header='Brands'>
      <RefinementList
        attribute='brand'
        searchablePlaceholder='Search brands'
        searchable={true}
        showMore={true}
      />
    </Panel>
  </DynamicWidgets>

  <SearchBox />
  <Hits />
</InstantSearchNext>
```

However, by adding `DynamicWidgets` component I'm not able to see `RefinementList` components rendered on the web.
